title: Add discount codes with eligibility rules
story: As a shopper, I want to apply a discount code during checkout so that eligible orders receive the correct saving without breaking cart totals.
explanation: Simple words me: user checkout par coupon code lagayega. Code tabhi chalega jab cart ki value minimum limit se zyada ho, code expire na ho, aur discount total se zyada na ho jaye. Galat code par cart total change nahi hona chahiye.
requirements: Support STUDENT10 for 10% off when subtotal is at least ₹500.
Support FIRST500 for ₹500 off when subtotal is at least ₹1,999.
Reject expired and unknown codes with a clear message.
Never allow discount to exceed the cart subtotal.
Return subtotal, discount, total, appliedCode, and message in one result object.
Keep the implementation reusable as a pure function where possible.
acceptanceCriteria: STUDENT10 on ₹1,000 gives ₹100 discount and ₹900 total.
FIRST500 on ₹2,500 gives ₹500 discount and ₹2,000 total.
FIRST500 on ₹1,200 is rejected because the minimum is not met.
Unknown codes do not change the total.
edgeCases: Cart quantity changes after coupon is applied
regressionChecks: removeItem still removes only the selected product
calculateSubtotal remains unchanged when no coupon is applied

rubric.criterion: Feature tests catch missing or incorrect behavior

title: Add note search with tag filtering
story: As a student, I want to search notes by title, body, or tag so that I can revise the right topic quickly.
explanation: Simple words me: student search box me word likhega. Note ke title, body ya tag me woh word mile to note dikhna chahiye. Search chhote-bade letters ko ignore kare aur latest note pehle aaye.
requirements: Ignore letter case and extra spaces.
Optional tag filter must narrow results.
Empty query returns all notes for the selected tag.
Keep the implementation reusable as a pure function where possible.
acceptanceCriteria: Query 'dbms' finds a note tagged DBMS.
Tag filter excludes notes without that tag.
regressionChecks: deleteNote still removes only the selected note

rubric.criterion: Feature tests catch missing or incorrect behavior

title: Add category budget alerts
story: As a user, I want warnings when a category budget is close to or above its limit.
explanation: Simple words me: agar kisi category me budget ka 80% kharch ho jaye to warning aayegi. 100% se zyada ho jaye to exceeded alert aayega. Kam kharch par koi alert nahi aana chahiye.
requirements: Warn when usage is at least 80% and below 100%.
Mark exceeded when usage is at least 100%.
Ignore categories without a positive budget.
Return category, spent, budget, percent, and level.
Keep the implementation reusable as a pure function where possible.

rubric.criterion: Feature tests catch missing or incorrect behavior
